title: Tech Note: Catalog Functions in ODBC Pro
author: Noreddine Margoum, QA Engineer, 4D S.A.
featured_technology: ODBC catalog functions (ODBC_SQLTables, ODBC_SQLColumns, ODBC_SQLPrimaryKeys, ODBC_SQLForeignKeys, etc.)

historical_commentary.text: This note documents the ODBC Pro plug-in's catalog introspection commands (tables, columns, keys, privileges, stored procedures) used to build dynamic SQL against external databases, a common integration pattern before 4D had any native SQL support. The general concept of querying a database's catalog/metadata to build dynamic queries remains standard practice, but the specific ODBC Pro plug-in commands shown are tied to a legacy 4D plug-in generation that predates 4D's built-in SQL engine (v11, 2007) and later native ODBC/SQL data-source connectivity improvements.
related_updates: 4D introduced its own integrated SQL engine and later native external SQL data source connectivity, reducing reliance on the standalone ODBC Pro plug-in for many use cases
ODBC Pro as described here (a separate plug-in with dedicated ODBC_SQL* commands) is a legacy component distinct from 4D's modern built-in ODBC/SQL support
